initialization: fresh IL70 run, state collections0; exact native selfresume retains allcurriculum state; no transplant from uniform/nativeG8 toG16

hooks.make_scene_stream: super creates original uniform SceneStream; wrapper replaces self.stream only for online_priority
hooks.bind_training_state: super then stream.bind(state); validate pending rollout; called after restore before firstat
hooks.at: idempotent persistent prepared selection; returns token+position containing curriculum_selection_id
hooks.commit: on_collection_committed after finalizedA and native collections/cursor increment, once per fresh collection before behavior/checkpoint publication
hooks.boundary: super core validation + private curriculum/nativeplan/counters; metadata included in ranksummary
hooks.public: small summary only; full bank/RNG/plan/counters remains in native state, not public JSON

math.eligibility: variance(actualSafety rawA)>=1e-6 AND (mixed strictfeasible OR allfeasible with normalizedEP headroom>=1e-4)
math.weighting: mixed: min(1,varA*(1+4p*(1-p))); allfeasible: min(1,varA*(1-meanEP)); allfail/saturated not automatically admitted
math.uniform: base.at(uniform_draws*world,rank); drawcount increases only on uniform commit, not priority
math.schedule: warmup8 collections then each divisible-by4 collection priority; first12; fallbackuniform if empty/cooldown/cap
math.no_importance_correction: intentional training-distribution experiment, not an unbiased uniform objective estimator

telemetry.priority_exposures: every priority sample is a replay of its ownrank observed TRAIN scene
telemetry.repeated_priority_exposures: additional priority repeats after the first priority sample for thatscene
telemetry.repeat_scene_exposures: all exposures minus distinct observedscene count, includes uniform epoch repeats
telemetry.stochastic_feedback_delta: recorded only; not used as a causal learning-progress/forgetting estimate

parent_data_contract: Same original103288 fullmanifest; priorDEV explicitly train diagnostic; no NAV/DEV evaluation list consumed. Underlying SceneStream validates token and physical-log eligibility.
scope_note: rank-local priority bank contains only ownrank uniform history; uniform global positions preserve distinct rank residues. Source epoch repeats/padding retain original semantics; this5k/10k pilot stays before fulluniform epoch wrap.
